title: Space/set update forwards listed core key closedAt
description: space.rs ~L1153: Space/set update buckets a key into clean_patch when it is in SPACE_METADATA_FIELDS or listed by ChatBackend::space_extension_properties. A backend listing 'closedAt' (a server-set core Space property, draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 L820) lets a client patch closedAt through apply_space_metadata_patch, contrary to the space_extension_properties doc ('A listed key that is already a core Space property ... keeps its core meaning'). JMAP-y3f2.16 fixed only the create path. Fix: apply the same core/structural-key exclusion on update (closedAt -> invalidProperties).
close_reason: Committed and adversarially verified (batch 7); CI at 84a9b7bc
